wireContract: Adds authorized GET /communities/:communityId/handle-nationality-authoring and POST /communities/:communityId/handle-nationality-qualification-policies. The seller supplies an allowlist and server-issued authoring reference; both providers and explicit lifetime remain server-resolved. Offering responses admit the curated_nationality_v1 successor with independent qualification identity and v3 offering hash. Existing none_v1 and private account-allowlist schemas and commands remain unchanged. Nationality quote/reservation/claim paths still fail closed pending qualification enforcement; this release is not capability advertisement or production acceptance. A compatible consumer is required before nationality offerings are advertised.
